OpenAI: OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company known for the GPT model family and ChatGPT.
Anthropic: Anthropic is an AI safety and research company that builds the Claude family of AI models.
Mistral AI: Mistral AI is a French AI company building open-weight and commercial large language models.
Hugging Face: Hugging Face is a platform and community hub for sharing machine learning models, datasets, and applications.
Figure AI: Figure AI is a robotics company developing general-purpose humanoid robots.
Boston Dynamics: Boston Dynamics is a robotics company known for advanced mobile and humanoid robots including Atlas and Spot.
Stability AI: Stability AI is the company behind the Stable Diffusion family of open image-generation models.
DeepSeek: DeepSeek is a Chinese AI research lab known for its open-weight large language models.
Black Forest Labs: Black Forest Labs is an AI company focused on generative image and video models, including the FLUX model family.
Qwen: Qwen is Alibaba Cloud's large language model family, released with open weights across multiple sizes.
